summary: Verified iter90jo bug fix: import-wizard commit-journals no longer creates FI journal entries. Only bank_statements + bank_transactions (with auto_je_id='') are created. FI entries will be generated later at comptabilisation. New test iter90jo_no_fi_at_import validates the new contract (journal_entries=0, note in response, bank_txn.auto_je_id=''). Updated pre-existing iter90jk test #3 which had asserted JE creation - now asserts JE absence + bank_transaction canonical account 55133100. Bilan/resultat regression on ACP 138cfd69 confirmed intact (compte_499=1170.16, equilibre=True, total_actif=14355.15, total_charges=5333.51).
critical_code_review_comments: import_wizard.py:1766-1770 correctly replaces the FI JE creation block with je_id='' - matches PRD contract.
commit-journals response at line 1904-1912 returns journal_entries=0 with explanatory 'note' field - good for frontend consumers.
bank_transactions insert at line 1791-1811 sets auto_je_id=je_id (which is now '') - verified.
Pre-existing iter90jk test #3 asserted JE FI creation; had to update to reflect the new contract (test-file fix only).

Two unrelated tests (test_iter90i_private_fees_excluded_from_expenses.py, test_iter90i7_fund_call_duplicate_ap_ve.py) fail with pre-existing event-loop async issues; unrelated to this change. Documented for main agent.
